# Documentation Excellence v4.6 R1 — Language Excellence

Generated documentation now uses clearer, more concise and more consistent
instruction wording before it reaches Document Workspace or Word. Existing
recordings and Reviews benefit automatically without migration.

Language Excellence is deterministic and renderer-neutral. It standardizes only
safe expressions, preserves Business Central terminology and respects the tone
contract of the selected Document Profile. It never invents information or
changes workflow structure, screenshots, annotations or semantic intent.

Word export uses the existing Document Plan and adapter without renderer changes.
No AI functionality was introduced.

R1 is production ready with no known blocking issue.
